import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(10,4))
# Door seal section
ax1.set_title("Door seal section (plan view)")
ax1.set_xlim(0,10); ax1.set_ylim(0,10)
# wall panel
ax1.fill([0,2,2,0],[1,1,9,9], color='lightgray')
ax1.text(0.3,5,"wall 100mm", rotation=90, fontsize=8)
# door leaf
ax1.fill([6,8,8,6],[1.5,1.5,8.5,8.5], color='tan')
ax1.text(6.2,5,"door leaf", rotation=90, fontsize=8)
# gasket uncompressed vs compressed
ax1.plot([2,6],[8,8],'k--')
ax1.plot([2,6],[2,2],'k--')
ax1.fill([2,6,6,2],[3,3,4,4], color='black')
ax1.text(2.5,6.5,"magnetic gasket\n3mm compression", fontsize=8)
ax1.annotate("fixed wall", xy=(1,9), fontsize=8)
ax1.annotate("moving door", xy=(7,9), fontsize=8)
ax1.set_xticks([]); ax1.set_yticks([])
# Rack guard
ax2.set_title("Rack tier with guard rail")
ax2.set_xlim(0,10); ax2.set_ylim(0,10)
ax2.fill([1,9,9,1],[1,1,2,2], color='gray')
ax2.text(4,1.3,"rack shelf", fontsize=8)
for x in [2,4,6,8]:
    ax2.fill([x-0.8,x+0.8,x+0.8,x-0.8],[3,3,5,5], color='green', alpha=0.6)
ax2.text(3.5,4,"20kg crates", fontsize=8)
ax2.plot([1,9],[6,6],'r-', linewidth=3)
ax2.text(4,6.5,"guard rail 50mm above shelf", fontsize=8, color='red')
ax2.plot([1,1],[1,6],'k-', linewidth=2)
ax2.plot([9,9],[1,6],'k-', linewidth=2)
ax2.text(1.2,7.5,"fixed posts", fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xticks([]); ax2.set_yticks([])
fig.tight_layout()
